posts.cooked:
While trying to submit BPT1_problem_2 in virtual machine ,it shows Evaluation failed . I need to know What I’m doing wrong or there is any grammatical misunderstanding done by me. Also,it doesn’t show where it’s failing

Screenshot (233)1366×768 56.4 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: The output clearly says what is wrong in the last line, please read the output properly. We cannot discuss the solution since it is a graded question.

posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked:
Please correct me If I’m wrong , I know that it is graded question and can’t be discussed and I don’t need the solution code to be discussed But As per my solution to the question I have created a soft link as per asked in the question . I want to know that I created the link with respect to the question is correct or not because as per my understanding I have created the link as per the question . There might be a flaw in my understanding . Please point it out so that I can solve the Assignment. if It can’t discussed publicly please give your mail id where we can discuss it anonymously.

Screenshot (236)1366×768 30.8 KB

Screenshot (237)1366×768 13.5 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: No your soft link is not created correctly. You can also see in the last line of the output. Id advice you to read the section on softlinks in the Navigating Linux Book, there I have especially pointed out the exact mistake you have done.

posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked: Thank your Sir, I’ve figured out the issue using your Navigating Linux Book. i.e While creating soft link relative path won’t work we must use absolute path. Now I have submitted my assignment successfully.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Great, well not completely, relative path will also work, but it has to be relative from the path of the link, and not the cwd
